data_collection.description: Chat widget collects customer name, email and order ID before the chat starts.
data_collection.data_types: name, email, order ID, phone number

data_preprocessing.description: Chat text is cleaned and tokenised; no personal identifiers are removed.

prompt_submission.description: Customer questions are sent as prompts; customers sometimes paste card or ID numbers.
prompt_submission.data_types: query text, payment details, delivery address

model_inference.description: A hosted language model generates the reply from the prompt and chat history.

output_generation.description: The bot shows the answer to the customer and may repeat order details.

data_storage.description: Full transcripts are stored in a database for quality review and analytics.

data_sharing.description: Transcripts are shared with an analytics vendor to improve responses.

data_deletion.description: Records are deleted manually when a customer complains; no schedule exists.

pia.business_purpose: Answer customer questions about orders, returns and delivery.
pia.collection_methods: Chat widget on the shop website
pia.storage_retention: Transcripts stored for 730 days in a central database
pia.identified_risks: Payment details in prompts; long retention; no deletion procedure.
pia.mitigation_measures: Redaction of prompts, retention limit, deletion workflow.
pia.residual_risks: Third-party processing will remain after mitigation.
pia.conclusion_notes: Proceed to deployment only after critical risks are completed.

findings.data_category: query text, payment details, delivery address
findings.risk_title: Exposure of sensitive information in prompts
findings.risk_description: Sensitive data may be typed or pasted into prompts and sent to the model without redaction.
findings.data_involved: query text, payment details, delivery address
findings.mitigation: Redact personal identifiers and sensitive values before sending prompts to the AI model; add an input warning telling users not to enter card or ID numbers.
findings.evidence: Scan on 2026-10-13 11:22: 3 sensitive item(s) found in a test prompt (Person name, Email address, Phone number, Payment card number, Aadhaar-format ID, Credential / OTP / CVV). Likelihood set to 5 from test evidence.

findings.risk_title: Personal data leakage through generated outputs
findings.risk_description: The model may repeat or reveal personal data from prompts, history or training context in its replies, and outputs are not checked.
findings.mitigation: Test generated outputs for accidental disclosure; add an output filter that masks personal data; limit the context passed to the model.
findings.evidence: Scan on 2026-10-13 11:22: 2 personal item(s) repeated in a model output (Email address, Phone number). Likelihood set to 5 from test evidence.

findings.data_category: query text, payment details, delivery address
findings.risk_description: Access controls are not implemented, so staff or attackers may read personal data.
findings.data_involved: query text, payment details, delivery address
findings.mitigation: Restrict access using role-based access control, encryption and audit logging; restrict access to prompt logs.

findings.risk_title: Lack of a data deletion procedure
findings.risk_description: Personal data is processed but no documented deletion procedure exists, so data may never be erased.
findings.mitigation: Establish secure deletion procedures covering databases, logs and backups; handle deletion requests within a defined time.

findings.data_category: query text, payment details, delivery address
findings.risk_title: Potential prompt logging and information exposure
findings.risk_description: Prompts and responses are logged; logs may contain personal or sensitive text.
findings.data_involved: query text, payment details, delivery address
findings.mitigation: Restrict access to prompt logs; mask personal data before logging; set a short retention period for logs.

findings.risk_description: Personal data is processed in identifiable form at this stage.
findings.mitigation: Anonymize or pseudonymize data at preprocessing (mask names, emails, IDs); re-test that individuals cannot be re-identified.

findings.risk_description: Data is kept for 730 days. Keeping personal data longer than needed increases exposure if it is breached.
findings.mitigation: Define and enforce data retention periods (for example 30-90 days for chat logs) with automatic expiry.
